title: The Eleventh Commandment
tagline: An informal ecclesiastical tribunal, an obscure Roman priest, and the celestial art of the pride tariff.
summary: Autumn 2026. Inside an isolated church vestry, an informal tribunal gathers to question the Aureans—followers of a massive, mathematically unforgeable fourth-century scripture with only three chapters and one unexpected eleventh commandment: 'Thy shalt pay.'
